title: hazard2csep: From seismic hazard models to testable earthquake forecasts
description:
hazard2csep is a Python application that converts the source models of Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Analysis (PSHA), written in the OpenQuake format, into gridded earthquake forecasts that can be evaluated with the Collaboratory for the Study of Earthquake Predictability (CSEP) testing framework. It bridges seismic hazard models (e.g., the European Seismic Hazard Model ESHM20) and prospective forecast testing with pyCSEP and floatCSEP.

Main functionalities:

  • Read, create and merge the spatial-magnitude regions of source model components (area sources, faults, background seismicity).
  • Intersect regions of different source models so that testing is performed on a common region.
  • Project source-model rates onto CSEP-style spatial-magnitude grids, producing testable forecast files.

hazard2csep was developed within the EU project Geo-INQUIRE (Grant Agreement No. 101058518) and is used to test the components of the European Seismic Hazard Model (ESHM20) against observed seismicity, as part of the European Forecast Testing Center (eqstats.efehr.org).
